u0: The episode starts here, before the matching key has been seen. Explore the corridor and side rooms to bring the matching key into the agent's clear 7x7 view; key_found then latches the machine into u1.
u1: The matching key has been seen but is not yet in hand. Navigate to the key, using its known left-column location, and pick it up so has_matching_key becomes true, advancing to u2.
u2: The agent holds the matching key and must now avoid opening the locked target door. Drop the key on an empty reachable cell without toggling the locked door; when the key is no longer carried and the target door remains closed with no target pickup, the machine advances to uf.
uf: Terminal success state: the matching key has been dropped and the locked target door is still closed, so the locked door was not opened. No further transitions are needed; the agent can continue avoiding toggling the locked door and never pick up the ball.
